name: Halvor
description: Once the ash-raker who seemed good for nothing, he proves fearless and relentless, killing three trolls, losing his love by breaking a vow, and trudging on until he wins her back at Soria Moria.
visualPrompt: A young Norwegian man with tousled dark hair and a sturdy build, first seen in soot-smudged ragged clothes by a hearth, later in splendid princely garments with a simple ring; determined eyes, travel-worn cloak and boots, carrying a plain sword

name: The Youngest Princess
description: The loveliest of the three sisters Halvor frees, clever and commanding; she gifts him the wishing ring, enforces the taboo, and is nearly wed to another before recognizing Halvor by the ring.
visualPrompt: A radiant young princess with long fair hair and calm, intelligent eyes, wearing elegant pale garments and fine jewelry; poised and resolute, holding a small ring as if it carries great power

name: The Nine-Headed Troll
description: The greatest and toughest of the castle trolls, massive enough to squeeze through a doorway sideways, whose defeat reunites the three princesses.
visualPrompt: An enormous hulking troll with nine grotesque heads clustered on thick necks, gray-green skin, heavy limbs, and a menacing sideways stance as it forces itself through a grand doorway; brutal, mythic presence

name: The Old Woman of the Forest Hut
description: A strange, very old woman in a lonely forest hut who bargains for Halvor’s horse and provides magic boots, then calls on the moon and the West Wind to guide him toward Soria Moria.
visualPrompt: A tiny, bent, gray-haired old woman in a dim rustic hut, with an absurdly long nose reaching toward the hearth; wrapped in rough wool and shawls, shrewd eyes, holding worn old boots that seem faintly enchanted

name: The West Wind
description: A roaring force of nature that knows the way to Soria Moria and carries Halvor at a punishing pace toward the wedding preparations.
visualPrompt: A powerful anthropomorphic wind-spirit formed from swirling air and cloud, suggested as a tall translucent figure made of gusts and flying leaves, rushing over mountains and forests with unstoppable energy
